findings.title: Admin authorization check is permanently short-circuited by or True
findings.evidence: The guard is now 'if not (request.user.is_staff or True):'; because 'request.user.is_staff or True' always evaluates true, the negation is always false and the raise is unreachable. A non-staff authenticated user calling admin_panel proceeds to render_admin(), bypassing the intended staff-only authorization.
findings.recommendation: Restore the original staff check to 'if not request.user.is_staff:' and add a regression test asserting that a non-staff user receives PermissionDenied from admin_panel.
